feywild_lexicon.category.feywild.feywild: When a Fey passes on to the next world, they leave behind a pinch of Fey Dust. This dust is valued by craftsmen as it can be condensed into the rare and precious Fey Ore.
Fey, a treatise on the wild and whimsical.
These Fey take on the aspect of one of the seasons. Each is a representative of their seasonal court.
In order to summon the Fey you will need a Fey Altar- which can be crafted in a crafting table. You can summon any fey you want, regardless of their alignment to a certain court.
feywild_lexicon.entry.feywild.feywild.fe: When a Fey passes into the next world, they leave behind a small amount of Fey Dust. This magical powder pervades all plants, creatures, and items native to the Feywild, and can be obtained in more peaceful ways by offering cookies to untamed Pixies. Alternatively, you can get Fey Dust from Fey Ore.
You can break a Fey Gem back down into dust by smelting it.
Pixies love Cookies, as most Fey do! You can give a hungry Fey cookies to restore some of their health and maybe receive a Fey Dust.
Fey gems are sought after by some wizards and creatures because it is a refined form of the Fey's original magic. Fey Ore can be found deep underground in the Overworld.
Condensing fey dust together can create a fey gem, but it will result in some loss of ingredients.

Did you ever find your shoes laced together after a good night's sleep? Or the sugar in your tea suddenly turn to salt? Did you ever travel through the forest swearing you saw something in the corner of your eye or hearing the giggle of a child's voice? Don't fret, you're not going mad! It's just the local Fey showing you that they care for you in their own very special way.

The Fey are pranksters- tricksters who enjoy teasing us big folk. Most of the time they are harmless, but just as with us, there may be a bad seed or two amongst them. It's hard to gain the trust of the Fey, as they see the world in a different way that we do.
In order to summon the Fey you will need a Fey Altar- which can be crafted in a crafting table.

With the right combination of ingredients to establish a sympathetic link to your desired Fey, and the incantation written on a summoning scroll with magic ink, you can summon Fey out of the Feywild and into your realm.
Be Careful; Mandrakes can be very loud when grown. Growing a mandrake requires farm land.

You can summon a fey by $(italic)using their Summoning Scroll on a block$(); the scroll will vanish. Each kind of Fey has their own summoning scroll, and the recipes for each can be found on their corresponding pages [or by using JEI/REI].

By right clicking your fey with a Pixie Orb, you can open the Fey Menu. Each fey has one. In this menu you can turn on/off their ability, make them follow or stay or you can dismiss them back into the summoning scroll.
Fey creatures shun iron, for its cold touch dampens their magic and kills their spirits.
feywild_lexicon.entry.feywild.feywild.pi: Commonly seen frolicking in the Blossoming Wealds without a care in the world, the Spring Pixie is often called the cutest and sweetest of the Fey- and she's more than happy to explore the world and make new friends. Just don't forget that sweetness and kindness are two different things!

A Spring Pixie summoned by this scroll will cast a spell that causes nearby animals to fall in love (if the right conditions are met for breeding). As a reminder, you can open a menu with options to toggle on/off her ability by interacting with her with a Pixie Orb.
Pixies love Cookies, as most Fey do! You can give a hungry Fey cookies to restore some of their health.

A caretaker through and through, the Autumn Pixie is happy to look after anyone who comes to her. Though not particularly inclined to venture out into the larger world, she knows much about the mysteries of the Feywild and will do her best to support those she cares about.
An Autumn Pixie summoned by this scroll will harvest items from crops nearby. As a reminder, you can open a menu with options to toggle on/off her ability by interacting with her with a Pixie Orb.
Pixies love Cookies, as most Fey do! You can give a hungry Fey cookies to restore some of their health.

In the Summer Court, even the smallest Pixie is endowed with the status and authority of their Court- and they'll make sure you remember that! If you manage to earn the favor of such a Fey, however, then you may gain a potent ally who will help guide you through thick and thin.

A Summer Pixie summoned by this scroll will cast a spell that will cast sunlight on nearby crops making them grow. As a reminder, you can open a menu with options to toggle on/off her ability by interacting with her with a Pixie Orb.
Pixies love Cookies, as most Fey do! You can give a hungry Fey cookies to restore some of their health.

As with the rest of her Court, the Winter Pixie is soft-spoken, fairly withdrawn, and often given to... morbid interests. Cold and sullen at a first glance, they will often warm up to those willing to help the Feywild through its harshest and deadliest season.

A Winter Pixie summoned by this scoll will gather part of a animal nearby, leaving behind their item drops. As a reminder, you can open a menu with options to toggle on/off her ability by interacting with her with a Pixie Orb.
Pixies love Cookies, as most Fey do! You can give a hungry Fey cookies to restore some of their health.
feywild_lexicon.entry.feywild.feywild.au: The Autumn Court is the most mature of the four Fey Courts, and their age and wisdom has given them a appreciation of fine art, music and poetry. They would rather spend a night listening to songs, dancing, and flirting than going to combat or mindlessly indulging themselves. They know the upcoming period will be a harsh one, and feel the responsibility of preparing for the end of a cycle.

Perhaps the kindest of the Courts, the Autumn Fey are still fully capable of trickery and mischief; they are just more hush-hush about it. The Autumn Court will protect the Feywild from any evil spirits and harvest souls who have gone astray. To honor the lost souls, and to give them one more good time before they pass on to the next stage.
You can grow your own giant mushrooms by bone-mealing red or brown mushrooms planted on podzol, and then carefully harvest them with shears.
feywild_lexicon.entry.feywild.feywild.sp: Bouncy, bubbly, and completely devoid of the idea of personal space, the Fey of the Spring Court treat everything as if they have never seen it before. They are like hyperactive children- always wondering what everything is, stuffing anything into their mouth that seems remotely edible, and only particularly concerned about not having enough fun or food for the day. They represent the birth of a new year and the coming of new life, and are the most innocent of the
Courts. However, they are notoriously obnoxious when playing pranks- as they do not know of the dangers or consequences of their actions. ...Nor do they care about that, for that matter!

You can find Giant Dandelions in three variations: budding, flowering, and the flower's well known fluff- ready to scatter its seeds to the wind. The flower will also drop dandelion seeds, which can be planted to grow your own giant dandelions.
feywild_lexicon.entry.feywild.feywild.su: The Summer Court is the primary reigning Court within the Feywild, and they know it! Haughty and demanding, they expect everyone who addresses them to treat them as the royals they are. The other Courts and inhabitants of the Feywild are there to serve them, and though polite, they demand recognition of their self-proclaimed royal status.

The Summer Court defends the Feywild from intruders who seek to take a hold of the Faerie Court's riches; they are more combat-focused than the other Courts as a result- quick to answer any threat or opposition with their righteous judgment.
You can find Giant Sunflowers, which will turn to face the sun's position in the sky. They can also drop sunflower seeds, which can be used to grow your own giant sunflowers.
feywild_lexicon.entry.feywild.feywild.wi: When the leaves have fallen, the sky has turned to gray, and the night closed in on the day- that's when the Winter Court reigns supreme in the Feywild. These Fey are apathetic to the living and their power struggles; eventually death will come for us all, and their purpose is to make sure the Feywild sees another turn of the year.

Winter Fey tend to be soft spoken, slightly morbid, and never choose their words without thinking about them. They seem to be a bit on the awkward side in social dealings, and some prefer the company of the dead.
The Giant Crocuses will open their flowers during the day and close them at night. The flower will also drop crocus seeds, which can be used to grow your own giant crocus.
